title: Arm opens AI Portal connecting 22 million developers to optimized models
summary: Arm unveiled its AI Portal on September 8 as a single entry point that connects more than 22 million developers and their agents to models pre-optimized for Arm-based cloud, edge and physical AI targets. The launch catalog includes Alibaba Qwen, Google Gemma and Ultralytics YOLO running on ExecuTorch, LiteRT and ONNX-RT, with developer tooling to bring and optimize proprietary models. Arm CSS for Mobile 2 is the first platform to be wired into the portal with SME2 and neural-GPU acceleration exposed directly.
